result:
I’d make it impossible to treat another person’s suffering as unreal just because it’s far away.

Not force everyone to agree, or make every decision painless. Just remove that convenient distance between “this is happening to someone” and “this matters.”

It wouldn’t solve everything. People can understand suffering and still choose cruelty. But I think a great deal of harm survives because those who could stop it never have to feel its weight.
